description:
Java port of ragleap-rag's RAG pipeline: connection pooling,
        embeddings (7 providers), vector storage on six backends
        (pgvector, FAISS, Qdrant, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone; Milvus
        and Pinecone are not live-verified; sparse and hybrid RRF
        search on pgvector), retrieval, generation (streaming,
        structured output, provider fallback, vision captioning),
        conversation memory, query rewriting, and ingestion: a document
        parser for 27 of the Python package's 28 formats (no Parquet;
        legacy .xls needs the optional Apache POI dependency), OCR
        through the Tesseract binary, audio extraction from video
        through the ffmpeg binary, audio transcription (OpenAI Whisper,
        Deepgram or a custom function; not live-verified), and an
        ingestion service that ties them together - plus standalone
        utilities (chunking, sanitization, guardrails, cost tracking,
        evaluation scoring, structured-output validation,
        observability hooks). Independently versioned from the Python
        ragleap-rag package (see https://pypi.org/project/ragleap-rag/)
        rather than kept in lockstep; URL and batch ingestion and the
        high-level RagLeap entry point (ask, streaming, evaluation) are
        not yet ported. Every module here is genuinely tested;
        documented per-class where it is not live-verified.
